summary.text: Tamara Trujillo of Cheyenne is the Constitution Party's candidate for Secretary of State. She describes a career with the state Child Support Division and 17 years in accounting and procurement at the Cheyenne refinery.

paragraphs.text: Raised in Cheyenne; worked for the State of Wyoming's Child Support Division and then 17 years in accounting and procurement at the Cheyenne refinery.
